'''Antiatoms''' are formed by [[antiparticle]]s.

Whereas in atoms negatively charged electrons ($e^-$) orbit a positively charged nucleus consisting protons ($p^+$) and neutrons ($n$), in antiatoms, positrons ($e^+$) orbit a negatively charged nucleus consisting antiprotons ($\overline{p}$) and antineutrons ($\overline{n}$).
